title: Submit an effective IT support request
issue: Submit an effective IT support request
resolution_html:
1. Choose your faculty IT team or UIT based on who supports your service
  2. Explain the task and what is not working
  3. Include the relevant device, operating system, location and error message
  4. List troubleshooting already attempted and attach safe screenshots where useful
  5. Use the existing ticket thread for follow-up instead of creating duplicates
